title: Oracle Essbase Application
description: An Oracle Essbase application containing one or more databases (cubes) for multi-dimensional analysis. Applications serve as the top-level container for databases, scripts, connections, and security configuration.

name.description: Application name. Limited to 30 characters, must not contain spaces, and is case-insensitive.

owner.description: User ID of the application owner who created the application.

creationTime.description: Application creation timestamp in milliseconds since Unix epoch.

modifiedBy.description: User ID of the person who last modified the application.

modifiedTime.description: Last modification timestamp in milliseconds since Unix epoch.

status.description: Current runtime status of the application.

description.description: Human-readable description of the application purpose.

type.description: Storage type of the application. ASO is aggregate storage optimized for read-heavy workloads. BSO is block storage optimized for write-heavy workloads. CURRENCY is for currency conversion applications.

startTime.description: Timestamp when the application was last started, in milliseconds since Unix epoch.

connectedUsersCount.description: Number of users currently connected to the application.

role.description: The authenticated user's role for this application (e.g., app_manager).

easManagedApp.description: If true, the application is managed in EAS Lite instead of the Essbase web interface.

startStopAppAllowed.description: Whether users with read permission can start the application.

encrypted.description: Whether the application data is encrypted at rest.

aiConnection.description: Name of the AI connection configuration associated with this application.

links.description: HATEOAS navigation links for related resources.

VariablesSetting.description: Settings controlling substitution variable visibility and update permissions.

showVariables.description: Whether substitution variables are visible to users.

updateVariables.description: Whether substitution variables can be updated by users.

type.description: Media type of the linked resource.
